member.name: P:BusinessOS.Infrastructure.Data.BusinessOSDbContext.AllowUserTenantReassignment
member.summary: Allows an authorized company switch to change the active company on the user account. Business records still cannot move between companies.
Removes grants that let an ordinary tenant role read or rewrite another tenant. SystemAdmin.Manage is never seeded. It can be attached only by a caller who already holds it.

member.name: T:BusinessOS.Infrastructure.Diagnostics.DatabaseHealthCheck
member.summary: Readiness probe for SQL Server. Failure details are not returned to callers because provider exceptions can contain connection information.

member.name: T:BusinessOS.Infrastructure.Diagnostics.OpenAiHealthCheck

member.name: T:BusinessOS.Infrastructure.Diagnostics.SlowQueryInterceptor
member.summary: Logs slow database commands without capturing full SQL in production-style noise. Command text is only included at Debug level.

member.name: T:BusinessOS.Infrastructure.Diagnostics.StripeHealthCheck
